Equipment.NobleCharterDescription: A document certifying the owner's noble ancestry and family standing.
Equipment.ChronicleDescription: A family, historical or scholarly chronicle that the character grew up with and knows well.
Equipment.PersonalCrestDescription: A crest, colours or other emblem identifying membership in a known family or lineage.
Equipment.MusicalInstrumentDescription: An instrument inherited from a life among performers. The player chooses its specific kind.
Equipment.TrainedSnakeDescription: A tame, trained snake that has stayed with the character since their years in servitude.
Equipment.TrainedBirdDescription: A tame, trained bird. Its species can be chosen with the GM.
Equipment.CommonFormulaDescription: A written recipe for a specific alchemical compound of common rarity.
Equipment.CommonDiagramDescription: A detailed plan for crafting a specific item of common rarity.
Equipment.SacredSymbolDescription: A symbol of the Great Sun faith, received through an upbringing among the high clergy.
Equipment.LuckyCharmDescription: A small keepsake to which the character attributes special luck.

Friends.Hint: An optional story of an acquaintance and a keepsake. You may leave it blank.

Church.Name: Church
Church.Description: The local religion strongly influenced you. You spent many hours in church every day.

NorthArtisan.Name: Artisan
NorthArtisan.Description: An artisan inspired you and taught you to value art and craftsmanship.

NorthCount.Name: Count
NorthCount.Description: A count or countess had the greatest influence on you, teaching you self-control.

NorthMage.Name: Mage
NorthMage.Description: A mage taught you not to fear magic and to question everything.

Witch.Name: Witch
Witch.Description: A village witch had the greatest influence on you and showed you the value of knowledge.

Cursed.Name: Cursed person
Cursed.Description: A person suffering from a curse taught you never to judge anyone too harshly.

NorthPerformer.Name: Performer
NorthPerformer.Description: A performer had the greatest influence on you and taught you many ways to attract attention.

Merchant.Name: Merchant
Merchant.Description: A merchant taught you to be resourceful and quick-witted.

NorthCriminal.Name: Criminal
NorthCriminal.Description: A criminal had the greatest influence on you and taught you how to look after yourself.

NorthWarrior.Name: Warrior
NorthWarrior.Description: A soldier had the greatest influence on you and taught you to defend yourself.

GreatSun.Name: Cult of the Great Sun
GreatSun.Description: The church strongly influenced you. You spent years studying rituals and chants.

Exile.Name: Exile
Exile.Description: An exile had the greatest influence on you and taught you to question society's foundations.

NilfgaardCount.Name: Count
NilfgaardCount.Description: A count had the greatest influence on you and taught you to lead and manage people.

NilfgaardMage.Name: Mage
NilfgaardMage.Description: A mage taught you the importance of order and caution.

Investigator.Name: Investigator
Investigator.Description: An imperial detective had the greatest influence on you. You spent much time solving mysteries.

MageHunter.Name: Mage hunter
MageHunter.Description: A mage hunter had the greatest influence on you and taught you to fear magic and mages.

NilfgaardWarrior.Name: Warrior
NilfgaardWarrior.Description: A soldier had the greatest influence on you, telling stories of danger and adventure.

NilfgaardArtisan.Name: Artisan
NilfgaardArtisan.Description: An artisan inspired you and taught you to value skill and precision.

SentientMonster.Name: Sentient monster
SentientMonster.Description: A sentient monster taught you that not all monsters are evil.

NilfgaardPerformer.Name: Performer
NilfgaardPerformer.Description: A performer had the greatest influence on you and taught you self-expression.

Human.Name: Human
Human.Description: A human had the greatest influence on you and helped you question racist prejudices.

ElderArtisan.Name: Artisan
ElderArtisan.Description: An artisan inspired you and taught you to value the art of the Elder Races.

NobleWarrior.Name: Noble warrior
NobleWarrior.Description: A war dancer or defender of Mahakam had the greatest influence on you and taught you the meaning of honour.

HighBorn.Name: High-born
HighBorn.Description: A high-born person taught you pride and the rules of etiquette.

ElderPerformer.Name: Performer
ElderPerformer.Description: A performer had the greatest influence on you and helped you understand the importance of happiness and beauty.

Raider.Name: Raider
Raider.Description: A raider had the greatest influence on you and taught you that you have the right to take what you need.

Sage.Name: Sage
Sage.Description: A sage had the greatest influence on you and taught you the importance of the history of the Elder Races.

ElderCriminal.Name: Criminal
ElderCriminal.Description: A criminal had the greatest influence on you and taught you to follow your own rules.

Hunter.Name: Hunter
Hunter.Description: A hunter had the greatest influence on you and taught you to survive in the wilderness.

Peasant.Name: Lowland peasant
Peasant.Description: A lowland peasant had the greatest influence on you and taught you how to live happily.

Family.WitcherRule: Witchers do not receive family status rewards.

NorthAristocracy.Name: Aristocracy
NorthAristocracy.Description: You grew up in a wealthy manor where servants fulfilled your every wish. You were expected to behave well and make a good impression.

MageWard.Name: Mage's ward
MageWard.Description: You were placed in a mage's care at a young age. You lived comfortably but rarely saw your guardian, who was always busy.

NorthKnighthood.Name: Knighthood
NorthKnighthood.Description: You lived in a manor and were raised to become a proper lord or lady. Your future was decided at birth.

NorthMerchants.Name: Merchant family
NorthMerchants.Description: You grew up among merchants, surrounded by vendors' cries and clinking coins.

NorthArtisans.Name: Artisan family
NorthArtisans.Description: You grew up in a workshop, hearing hammers and other sounds of craft every day.

NorthPerformers.Name: Family of performers
NorthPerformers.Description: You grew up with an acting troupe, perhaps travelling with them or performing in a theatre.

NorthPeasants.Name: Peasant family
NorthPeasants.Description: You grew up on a remote farm. You owned very little and lived a simple but dangerous life.

NilfgaardAristocracy.Name: Aristocracy
NilfgaardAristocracy.Description: You grew up in a wealthy manor and learned to survive court intrigue. Luxury was an incentive to learn.

HighClergy.Name: High clergy
HighClergy.Description: You grew up among the priests of the Great Sun. You were a devout child, certain that the church would guide you.

NilfgaardKnighthood.Name: Knighthood
NilfgaardKnighthood.Description: You grew up knowing that serving the emperor was your duty and luxury was a reward for your future service.

NilfgaardArtisans.Name: Artisan family
NilfgaardArtisans.Description: You grew up in a workshop, learning to make goods that could be sold around the world and discovering the value of skill.

NilfgaardMerchants.Name: Merchant family
NilfgaardMerchants.Description: You grew up selling goods across the Empire and saw exotic wares from around the world.

Slavery.Name: Slavery
Slavery.Description: You were enslaved from birth. You lived in a simple room, worked hard and owned little.

NilfgaardPeasants.Name: Peasant family
NilfgaardPeasants.Description: You grew up on one of the Empire's thousands of farms. You owned very little, but life was simple.

ElderAristocracy.Name: Aristocracy
ElderAristocracy.Description: You grew up in a palace, constantly reminded of a glorious past and expected to live up to your ancestors.

NobleWarrior.Name: Noble warrior
NobleWarrior.Description: You are the child of a noble warrior, expected to uphold your family's reputation and honour your ancestors.

ElderMerchants.Name: Merchant family
ElderMerchants.Description: You grew up with travelling merchants. Life could be hard, but goods made by non-humans were always valued.

Scribes.Name: Family of scribes
Scribes.Description: Your family chronicled the history of the Elder Races, trying to preserve it for future generations.

ElderPerformers.Name: Performers
ElderPerformers.Description: You sang and performed on stage from childhood, helping with makeup or repairing musical instruments in your free time.

ElderArtisans.Name: Artisan family
ElderArtisans.Description: You grew up among artisans, visited ancient palaces for inspiration and spent many hours at work every day.

LowBorn.Name: Low birth
LowBorn.Description: You came from an ordinary family and earned your living cleaning other people's mansions or surviving on handouts in your home city.

Trust.Name: Trust
Trust.Description: +1 to Charisma, Seduction and Persuasion against other humans.

Stubbornness.Name: Stubbornness
Stubbornness.Description: Reroll a failed Resist Coercion or Courage check (up to 3 times per session; take the highest result; if the reroll fails, this ability cannot be used again).

Marksman.Name: Marksman
Marksman.Description: +2 to Archery; draw and string a bow without spending an action.

OneWithNature.Name: One with Nature
OneWithNature.Description: Animals are friendly and do not attack unless provoked; automatically find common or plentiful plant substances if they naturally occur in the area.

Tough.Name: Tough
Tough.Description: Skin has a natural stopping power of 2, added to any armor's stopping power and unaffected by ablation damage.

Witcher.Name: Witcher
Witcher.Note: Originally humans, transformed by mutations during the Trial of the Grasses.

EnhancedSenses.Name: Enhanced Senses
EnhancedSenses.Description: No penalties in dim light; +1 to Awareness; can track by scent.

MutantResilience.Name: Mutant Resilience
MutantResilience.Description: Immune to diseases; can use mutagens.

DulledEmotions.Name: Dulled Emotions
DulledEmotions.Description: No Courage checks against Intimidation; −4 to Empathy (minimum 1); Empathy cannot exceed 6.

LightningReflexes.Name: Lightning Reflexes
LightningReflexes.Description: +1 to Reflex and Dexterity (these values may exceed 10).

Picker.ReferenceOnly: Bonuses are reference text and must be applied manually for now.

Origins.WitcherRule: Witchers do not receive a region of origin bonus.
